title: LeagueSettings
description: Canonical, platform-neutral league settings. Adapters translate Sleeper scoring_settings, ESPN scoringItems, and CBS scoring rules INTO this shape; the scorer only ever reads this shape. Stat names are the canonical vocabulary in docs/product/draft-board.md section 2.2 (Sleeper snake_case, because it is the richest open vocabulary and the projection feed already speaks it).

games.description: Games each player's season projection is spread over. Per-game rules are evaluated per game and multiplied by this.

rounds.description: Defaults to the sum of starter counts + bench.

id.description: Display label: QB, RB, FLEX, W/T, SUPERFLEX, K, DST ...

unsupported.description: Platform rules the adapter recognised but the engine cannot price (IDP, return yards, punters, ...). Kept so the UI can say what is NOT modelled instead of silently dropping it.

model.description: Draft-model knobs. Everything here has a default; a league file only overrides what it must. See docs section 3.

floor_rounds_from_end.description: Earliest pick = first pick of round (rounds - n + 1). Reproduces Sleeper 145/169 (16 rounds x 12) and Dad 141/161 (18 x 10).

positions.description: Rule applies only to these positions. Omitted = all positions. Rules are ADDITIVE, so a TE premium is a second rec rule with positions [TE].

per_unit.description: Linear: points x stat. Closed form -- E[points] = points x E[stat]. Covers ~90% of every platform's scoring.

game_tiers.description: Per-GAME exclusive tiers: the single tier whose [min, max] contains the game's stat pays. Yardage bonuses (100-199 = 3, 200+ = 4), DST points-allowed and yards-allowed tables. Cumulative platforms are converted to exclusive ranges by the adapter. Needs the per-game distribution (E[tier(X)] != tier(E[X])).

game_step.description: Per-GAME whole-point steps: 0 below `start`, then `points` per full `every` beyond it, at most `max_steps` steps. ESPN 'every 25 rushing yards' (start=every=25), CBS whole-point yardage, Dad's 75/25/20-yard buckets and his 3-4 / 5-6 reception tiers (start=3, every=2).

start.description: Stat value that earns the first step. Defaults to `every`.

distance.description: Points per EVENT by its length: TD distance tables, long-TD bonuses (Sleeper rush_td_40p), FG distance buckets, per-yard FG scoring. Additive with any per_unit rule on the same event. Closed form given a per-player distance distribution -- each event is independent, so no simulation is needed.

per_yard.description: Extra points per yard of the event (Sleeper fgm_yds).
